title: On the Analysis of Misspecified Variational Inequalities with Nonlinear Constraints
summary: In this paper, we study a class of misspecified variational inequalities (VIs) where both the monotone operator and nonlinear convex constraints depend on an unknown parameter learned via a secondary VI. Existing data-driven VI methods typically follow a decoupled learn-then-optimize scheme, causing the approximation error from the learning to propagate the main decision-making problem and hinder convergence.
